rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone has enough courage to do something.

example.english: I don't dare walk the streets alone at night.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 je6 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when actively challenging person A to carry out action V, rather than merely saying that someone has courage.

example.english: I dare you to jump into the water—do you dare?
example.traditional: 我激你跳落水，你敢唔敢？
example.jyutping: ngo5 gik1 nei5 tiu3 lok6 seoi2 nei5 gam2 m4 gam2
